name: Premier Hospital Supply & O2 Solutions
old_description: The mission of Premier Hospital Supply / O2 Solutions is to set standards of excellence for providing respiratory care and medical equipment to patients and hospitals throughout New Mexico. Our ultimate goal is providing our patients and clients with quality service and care they deserve. We are dedicated in providing responsive, timely customer service. about:
Premier Hospital Supply & O2 Solutions operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, as a division of Premier Hospital Supply. The company provides respiratory care and durable medical equipment to patients and hospitals throughout the state.

The business focuses on two core service lines: sleep apnea therapy and home oxygen therapy. For sleep apnea, it supplies CPAP, VPAP, and APAP devices along with nasal, pillow, and full-face masks. For oxygen therapy, it offers portable oxygen concentrators, oxygen cylinders, stationary concentrators, and nebulizers. The company works directly with prescribing sleep physicians, receiving prescriptions and qualifying documents, then schedules in-person appointments with a respiratory therapist to review the sleep study, demonstrate equipment use, and explain insurance billing.

Customers include individual patients referred by sleep specialists, hospitals, and insurance providers across New Mexico. The company serves the broader healthcare, respiratory care, sleep medicine, and home healthcare sectors.

Founded on a mission to set standards of excellence, Premier Hospital Supply & O2 Solutions emphasizes responsive, timely customer service and commits to educating both staff and customers to achieve 100 percent compliance and satisfaction.
